title: The RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Machine Learning Challenge

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《The RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Machine Learning Challenge》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Purpose The Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) Pediatric Bone Age Machine Learning Challenge was created to show an application of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) in medical imaging, promote collaboration to catalyze AI model creation, and identify innovators in medical imaging.

evidence.text: Purpose The Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) Pediatric Bone Age Machine Learning Challenge was created to show an application of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) in medical imaging, promote collaboration to catalyze AI model creation, and identify innovators in medical imaging.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《The RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Machine Learning Challenge》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Materials and Methods The goal of this challenge was to solicit individuals and teams to create an algorithm or model using ML techniques that would accurately determine skeletal age in a curated data set of pediatric hand radiographs.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Results A data set consisting of 14 236 hand radiographs (12 611 training set, 1425 validation set, 200 test set) was made available to registered challenge participants.

evidence.text: Materials and Methods The goal of this challenge was to solicit individuals and teams to create an algorithm or model using ML techniques that would accurately determine skeletal age in a curated data set of pediatric hand radiographs.
Results A data set consisting of 14 236 hand radiographs (12 611 training set, 1425 validation set, 200 test set) was made available to registered challenge participants.
